recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male musician with a red beard holding an acoustic guitar in a grassy field at dusk. A large silhouette of a tree anchors the left side, while a vibrant orange and purple sunset fills the sky. The typography is bold, textured, and positioned in the lower-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm orange sky contrasts with the cool green and shadowed tones of the field.
The musician's gaze is directed away from the camera, following the horizontal line of the guitar neck.
The large tree silhouette balances the weight of the musician on the right side of the frame.
The glowing text in the foreground mimics the light quality of the sunset.
coreInvariants: Vibrant sunset sky with high-contrast clouds
Large deciduous tree silhouette on the left
Musician in casual attire with an acoustic guitar

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician is centered-right, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the tree on the left provides a heavy vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the musician's face, follows the guitar neck to the right, then sweeps across the sunset clouds to the tree, and finally down to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper-left (sky) and lower-right (grass) to allow the subject and text to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep greens and browns in the landscape provide a grounded base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant oranges and purples in the sky create emotional intensity.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm white and gold in the typography and guitar highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky against low-value, desaturated shadows in the foreground.

composition.overlap: Overlays the grass and tree trunk

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both name components to maintain a monolithic, sturdy feel.
graphicDevices: Inner glow on text to simulate backlighting
Subtle vignette to focus light on the center

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and modern-rustic balance.
Open-source alternative with similar wide stance and clean lines.
Offers a similar professional and sturdy appearance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photograph of a man with a red beard and baseball cap holding an acoustic guitar in a field at sunset. A large oak tree silhouette is on the left. The sky is filled with dramatic orange and purple clouds. The lighting is warm and directional from the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist's name in the bottom-left corner using a heavy, wide sans-serif font in all caps. Apply a subtle inner glow and a weathered texture to the letters so they appear integrated into the scene's lighting.

verificationChecks: Is the text legible against the dark grass?
Does the sky color feel natural yet dramatic?
Is the musician's pose relaxed and authentic?
Does the tree silhouette provide enough visual weight on the left?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Proprietary logos on the guitar headstock
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text doesn't obscure the musician's hands
Verify the horizon line is straight
Confirm the sunset glow reflects on the musician's skin and guitar
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dramatic natural landscape at golden hour with a centered-right subject and heavy, textured sans-serif typography anchored in the lower-left corner.
